text:
taylor: hey all :wave: i'm taylor, started on the product infra team today. hitting a snag with observability access - Grafana link redirects to Okta and then says 'You are not authorized to access this application'. Datadog shows a similar 403. who do i ping to get Datadog/Grafana/Sentry access?

megan: welcome taylor :tada: i handle onboarding for product infra. paste your Okta email and i'll queue the access. typical defaults: Datadog read, Grafana viewer, Sentry member (2FA required). If you need edit rights, include a short justification.

id-bot: id-bot created ticket IDP-4012 for taylor@redwood.com: "SSO entitlement failure for Grafana/Datadog/Sentry". Assigned to: megan.

megan: thanks. also try incognito to clear stale SSO cookies as a quick first step.

taylor: tried incognito, still lands on Okta -> 403. email is taylor.lane@redwood.com.

infra-bot: infra-bot created INFRA-4119: "Grafana invite + Datadog team add for taylor.lane@redwood.com". Owner: samir. ETA: 6h. Grafana invite will be sent when infra approves.

samir: cc @megan @taylor  quick note: Datadog membership is via SCIM group -> Datadog team mapping. If your Okta account isn't in the right group we queue a sync. I can trigger a manual sync if needed.

megan: i requested folder ACL for infra/grafana (viewer) and asked security for Sentry approval. @security-bot tagging for the Sentry add.

security-bot: security-bot recorded Sentry request SENTRY-1024 for taylor.lane@redwood.com. Security review queued (expected ~24h). Reminder: enable authenticator app for 2FA before accepting invite.

taylor: got an infra email from grafana@redwood.com - invite received and accepted! i can view dashboards but not the specific "infra/inference-costs" or the "infra/p95-by-model" dashboards. search returns no results.

megan: some dashboards live in restricted folders or are only present in Datadog and exposed via the Datadog datasource. i'll grant folder-level view and samir will verify Datadog membership.

samir: granted folder-level view for infra to taylor.lane@redwood.com and triggered a SCIM sync to add you to team 'inference-observability'.

id-bot: id-bot: SCIM sync queued for IDP-4012.

taylor: small follow-up: where are dashboard definitions stored? i'd like to propose a minor tweak to p95-by-model (default window 30d -> 7d).

megan: dashboard JSONs live in repo: platform/infra/grafana/dashboards. Preferred flow: export JSON, open PR with rationale, tag eng-product and eng-runtime reviewers. For Datadog dashboards, create saved queries and open a PR under infra/datadog. If it's just a local view change for your session, you can modify the dashboard time range in the UI without needing perms.

infra-bot: infra-bot: Datadog team add completed for taylor.lane@redwood.com -> team: inference-observability. You should now see Datadog monitors and dashboards.

taylor: confirmed Datadog is working now, can see monitors, cost dashboard, and p95 graphs. thanks! quick question on alert routing: how do i get pager notifications for the product-agent service?

megan: to get paged, you'll need to be added to the PagerDuty escalation policy for that service. file a request in #people-ops-support with the service name and whether you'll be on-call rotation. We'll add you after a runbook review.

security-bot: security-bot: SENTRY-1024 approved by security lead (taylor.lane@redwood.com). Invite will be issued once identity sync completes. Reminder: enable 2FA before accepting.

megan: added a note to the new-hire checklist: expect Grafana invites usually <1h, Datadog SCIM sync 1-4h (manual sync may be needed), Sentry approval ~24h. Also: dashboard edits require PR + justification.

taylor: great, everything's working now. appreciate the quick turnaround and the checklist notes :heart: If i run into edit permission questions i'll open a PR or DM.

megan: welcome again! if you want a quick 15m walkthrough of the key dashboards (latency, cost, cache hit rate) i'm happy to schedule.

taylor: would love that, thanks :raised_hands:
